name: Power Platform Academy
description:
Power Platform Academy is a premium, community-driven training program designed for professionals who want to master Microsoft Power Platform in real-world enterprise scenarios.

Led by Marcel Lehmann, Dual Microsoft MVP (Switzerland) and Michael Roth, Microsoft MVP, the academy delivers hands-on, practical learning focused on real business impact — not just theory.

Starting in just three weeks, the upcoming English-language edition brings together IT professionals, consultants, and decision-makers who want to:

  • Build scalable solutions with Power Apps

  • Automate processes using Power Automate

  • Implement governance & ALM strategies

  • Design enterprise-ready architectures

  • Leverage Power BI for actionable insights

If you're serious about elevating your Power Platform skills and learning directly from award-winning community experts, this is your opportunity.

name: ServiceNow
description:
ServiceNow is the leading digital workflow platform that helps organizations transform how work gets done. With deep and seamless integration into the Microsoft ecosystem, ServiceNow enables enterprises to connect people, processes, and technology across the entire organization.

By integrating natively with Microsoft tools such as Microsoft 365, Azure, Teams, and Power Platform, ServiceNow brings workflows directly into the applications employees use every day. This creates a unified experience where collaboration, automation, and service delivery come together—without silos.

Organizations benefit from enhanced IT service management, streamlined enterprise workflows, and improved visibility across cloud and on-premises environments. Combined with Microsoft’s secure and scalable cloud infrastructure, ServiceNow accelerates digital transformation while maintaining governance, compliance, and security.

Together, ServiceNow and Microsoft empower businesses to work smarter, respond faster, and deliver better experiences for employees and customers alike.

name: PowerBros
description:
Power Bros helps companies streamline work, eliminate manual processes, and improve the security of their Microsoft 365 and Power Platform environments. Their team specializes in workflow automation, detailed system audits, and custom app development designed to save time, reduce costs, and boost operational efficiency.

With clear communication, modern tools, and solutions tailored to each business, Power Bros makes it easy to modernize internal processes and stay ahead of risks—without unnecessary complexity.

If your organization is ready to work smarter, move faster, and operate more securely, Power Bros delivers the expertise to make it happen.

name: DesignKit for Power Apps
description:
DesignKit takes Power Apps development to the next level by connecting Figma → Canvas App in one workflow. With DesignKit you can design a full Power Apps UI in Figma, validate components, manage dependencies, and export real controls or YAML snippets directly into Power Apps — saving weeks of layout, styling, and handover time. Consultants can introduce entire projects visually thanks to the Dependency Model and PDF export functionality. DesignKit helps teams move from idea to production faster — with consistent design systems, repeatable patterns, and a smoother collaboration between designers and makers.

DesignKit — From prototype to Power App in one click.

name: Data Science Consulting
description:
Every successful AI project starts with a solid data foundation.

Data Science Consulting specializes in helping organizations modernize their data and AI capabilities through expert consulting, architecture, and strategy. Whether it's Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, data governance, or AI adoption, they work with businesses to build scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions.

Their team combines deep technical expertise with practical business experience to help organizations transform data into actionable insights and real business outcomes.

Interested in taking your data strategy to the next level? Visit Data Science Consulting to learn more about their services, explore their latest insights, and discover how they can help your organization succeed.

name: IT for Business Podcast
description:
IT for Business is the podcast for business leaders, IT decision-makers, and technology professionals who want to transform technology into measurable business success.

Each episode features industry experts, technology leaders, and real-world practitioners discussing cloud computing, cybersecurity, AI, Microsoft technologies, infrastructure, networking, virtualization, automation, and digital transformation.

Whether you're planning your next IT investment, modernizing your infrastructure, or preparing your organization for the future, IT for Business delivers practical insights, expert advice, and actionable strategies—without the marketing hype.

Because great technology isn't the goal. Better business outcomes are.
